test_title: PYST 04: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 05 Feb, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that best expresses the meaning of the underlined idiom.

Tushara was asked to gather demographic data that could be useful __down the road.__
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **In the future**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"down the road"** means at some point in the future. (भविष्य में)

 
 
• **Example: **We might face some challenges down the road, but we'll cross that bridge when we get there.
 
 
 
• **"In the future"** refers to a time that is yet to come. (भविष्य में)
 
 
• **Example: **She plans to travel around the world in the future.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **In the future**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **In the present** (वर्तमान में): Refers to the current time.

 
 
• **Example:** We need to focus on solving the issues in the present.
 
 
 
• **On the way** (रास्ते में): Refers to something that is currently in transit or progress.
 
 
• **Example:** The package is on the way and should arrive tomorrow.
 
 
 
• **In an informal way** (अनौपचारिक तरीके से): Refers to doing something without formality.
 
 
• **Example:** They decided to discuss the matter in an informal way over lunch.
 
 

32:Td5f,
The correct answer is '(1) vibr
